title: LoaderFunctionArgs
summary: Request arguments supplied to a server loader.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Provides request, decoded params, and signal, plus optional context: unknown. Pass signal to cancellable work. Read query parameters from request.url.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: The core does not inject an application context value. Supply context through an integration if needed and narrow it before use. Browser-only APIs must not be used by a server loader.
